finalText:
Build's clean now, exit code 0.

Two real bugs were hiding in that warning wall, both from the same bundler bump:

- `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. It crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated a missing flag as an error instead of "off." The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`.

Fixed both to match the new shapes. The rest really was just noise, deprecation notices and dedupe logs from the bump, nothing to fix there.
